domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The columns present in the dataset (InvoiceNo, StockCode, Description, Quantity, InvoiceDate, UnitPrice, CustomerID, and Country) perfectly match transactional data schemas standard in online or retail businesses, specifically mirroring the well-known Online Retail transaction dataset.

kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the total revenue generated across all transactions by summing the product of quantity and unit price.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total revenue is the primary high-level metric for assessing business scale and health, best represented as a single KPI card.

kpi_specs.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the average spend per unique invoice/transaction.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) / COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS average_order_value FROM data WHERE Quantity > 0
kpi_specs.reasoning: Average Order Value measures purchasing patterns and helps evaluate pricing strategies. Filtering for positive quantities excludes potential cancellations.

kpi_specs.name: Top 10 Countries by Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Identifies the highest revenue-generating countries outside of any single dominant market.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY Country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: A bar chart of top revenue countries helps visually compare geographic sales performance and target expansion or marketing efforts.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Sales Trend
kpi_specs.description: Tracks total revenue month-over-month to highlight seasonality and growth trends.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS sales_month, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS monthly_revenue FROM data GROUP BY sales_month ORDER BY sales_month ASC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A monthly timeline is essential for detecting seasonal peaks and determining the overall growth trajectory of the retail business.

kpi_specs.name: Top 10 Products by Quantity Sold
kpi_specs.description: Lists the top ten products based on total quantities ordered, along with their generated revenue.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT StockCode, Description, SUM(Quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue_contribution FROM data WHERE StockCode IS NOT NULL GROUP BY StockCode, Description ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: A table is chosen to provide a precise breakdown of the best-performing inventory items by volume and their financial contribution to the business.
